title: "Cannot find module" error is not logged in cluster mode
body:
OS: Ubuntu 14.04.1 LTS
node: 0.11.14
pm2: 0.12.3

I have one line in app.js:

``` javascript
var logger = require('logger'); // does not exist
```

Start process in fork mode:

``` javascript
pm2 start app.js
```

There is error description in logs:

```
Error: Cannot find module 'logger'
at Function.Module._resolveFilename (module.js:336:15)
at Function.Module._load (module.js:278:25)
at Module.require (module.js:365:17)
at require (module.js:384:17)
at Object. (/home/ubuntu/dev/app.js:1:63)
at Module._compile (module.js:460:26)
at Object.Module._extensions..js (module.js:478:10)
at Module.load (module.js:355:32)
at Function.Module._load (module.js:310:12)
at Function.Module.runMain (module.js:501:10)
```

Now try to start in cluster mode:

``` javascript
pm2 start app.js -i 0
```

Nothing about error...

In real app I use NODE_PATH and can't understand why application does not start. NODE_PATH is not used by app and module is not loaded though it exists. Very strange
